hero.subtitle: Container Rental Smarter & More Profitable!
hero.description: Whether you're a customer looking for reliable service, or a vendor aiming to grow your business, Beyati brings you together on one smart digital platform Simpler rentals, smarter tracking, and better profits

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are?
whoWeAre.description: Beyati is a digital platform specialized in rental and tracking of construction and general waste containers, connecting customers and renters in one unified and secure system. It enables customers to order and track containers online, and helps renters manage operations, receive orders, and maximize profits efficiently.

ourVision.title: Our vision
ourVision.description: To make Beyati the leading digital platform for container rental and waste management in the Kingdom, offering smart digital solutions that simplify customers' lives, empower renters, and promote environmental sustainability

ourMission.title: Our mission
ourMission.description: At Beyati, we believe that collaboration between customers and Renters is the key to success. Our mission is to enhance the quality of waste collection and container rental services through integrated digital solutions — including online payments, live tracking, reviews, and instant reporting. Our goal is to make container rental simpler, faster, and more profitable for everyone

booking.description: With Beyati, renting a container has never been easier! In just minutes, you can book your container and have it delivered right where you need it — fast, secure, and stress-free. We offer a fully digital experience with real-time tracking, flexible options, and secure online payments.

steps.chooseWasteTypeDescription: Start smart — choose the type of waste you want to dispose of, and we’ll provide the perfect container for your needs.
steps.chooseDateAndTimeDescription: Pick the best time for delivery or pickup, whenever it fits your schedule — your convenience comes first.
steps.selectRentalDurationDescription: From a day to a week or more — you decide the rental duration that fits your project and timeline.
steps.addDropOffLocationDescription: Share your location easily through the map, and we’ll deliver the container exactly where you need it.
steps.chooseContainerSizeDescription: Pick the size that matches your work —small for light waste, large for big projects. Beyati offers all sizes with fast and reliable service.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question2: How can I rent a container through the app?
faq.question3: Can I track my container after placing an order?
faq.question5: I own a container company — how can I benefit from Beyati?
faq.question6: Can I set the rental duration myself?
faq.question7: Is the service available in all cities?
faq.question8: Is there customer support if something goes wrong?
faq.answer1: Beyati is a smart digital platform for renting and tracking waste containers easily and reliably. It connects customers and renters in one place to offer faster, cheaper, and more organized service.
faq.answer2: It’s super easy! Download the app, choose the waste type, select the time, location, and container size — you’ll see a list of available Renters and can pick the one that best fits your needs. Everything happens digitally — no phone calls required!
faq.answer3: Yes, You can track your order status and container location in real-time using the in-app map. You’ll also receive instant notifications from delivery to final pickup
faq.answer4: Absolutely, You can pay safely using Mada, Visa, Mastercard, or Apple Pay, and all transactions are processed through Moyasar, a payment gateway licensed by the Saudi Central Bank.
faq.answer5: Beyati helps you increase orders and streamline operations easily. Register as a Renter, start receiving orders, and manage containers, drivers, and payments through an integrated dashboard.
faq.answer6: Yes, Flexibility is in your hands! Choose the rental period that suits your project — whether 10 days, 20 days, or a month — and we’ll handle delivery and pickup at your chosen time.
faq.answer7: Yes, Beyati is continuously expanding across cities in the Kingdom. Check the app to see which areas are currently covered, and if your area isn’t available yet — we’ll reach you soon!
faq.answer8: Of course, The Beyati support team is always ready to assist you via in-app chat or WhatsApp — ensuring a smooth and comfortable experience every time.
